name: RT SI Before Save
RT Filter Probe
script:
# Expose the *in-Python* filter path to the HTTP-only engine.
#
# frappe.utils.evaluate_filters / compare are the code that changed when
# `between` was added to operator_map in frappe/utils/data.py. Before that
# change these returned False for every `between` filter; after it they
# actually evaluate. There is no stock endpoint that reaches them, so the
# frappe_filters suite calls this probe and compares the answer with what the
# DB-side path (frappe.client.get_list) returns for the same bounds.
#
# No imports: safe_exec blocks __import__ and already provides `json`.
args = frappe.form_dict
probe_doc = json.loads(args.get("probe_doc") or "{}")
probe_filters = json.loads(args.get("probe_filters") or "[]")
probe_filters = [tuple(f) if isinstance(f, list) else f for f in probe_filters]

frappe.response["message"] = {
	"evaluate_filters": bool(frappe.utils.evaluate_filters(probe_doc, probe_filters)),
}
